dashboard.label: TA-journald Overview
dashboard.description: Collects journald log-plane metadata: journal disk usage (journalctl --disk-usage), journal file count under /var/log/journal, total journal size, age of the oldest journal file,

search.query: | mstats avg("journald.size_mb") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("journald.file_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("journald.oldest_age_hours") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("journald.service_active") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="journald:status" | dedup host | table host size_mb disk_kb file_count oldest_age_hours service_active
